source.title: The Art of the Armorsmith
source.description:
Satisfaction. It is what I draw from the hammer and the anvil. To see a proud Horde warrior protected under my steel reminds me of what it is to be alive. It is an addiction that I dare never give up, <name>.

I can not grant you this satisfaction, merely set you upon the path. As with all of life's endeavors, the path of the armorsmith is a journey.

If you wish to be one of the select few, you need only to ask and I shall train, but, a task you must first complete.
source.objective: To become an armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Okothos: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.
source.progress: I will pound the steel until the breath itself has been taken from me.
source.completion: This is the final step before you begin your new career as an armorsmith, <name>. Should you choose to back out, now would be your last chance. Otherwise, prepare yourself for a lifetime of glory.
